# Repository instructions: Markdown-first

Read [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [../DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](../DESIGN_SYSTEM.md).

- All study materials and navigation use Markdown, not HTML or GitHub Pages.
- Keep the root `README.md` and relevant subdirectory `README.md` indexes current with relative links.
- Zoe's finalized 24-topic source is `speaking/part2/people/IELTS_Part2_Zoe.md`. Preserve all 24 topics, two master examples, three-part template, and bold-change semantics.
- Preserve original IELTS Writing text and clearly distinguish real submission vs reference essays.
- Before committing, run `node scripts/check-markdown.mjs` and resolve broken local links.
